items.title: David Weinstein Interview, 1988-09-22
items.q: Oh, who was the violinist that you had?

ctx.x: The Dawn Busters itself would have been, I think, I'm trusting memory for a minute, somewhere around 41, 42. They stopped in 41 or 42? No, we started. We started. We started. We went off the air as Dawn Busters in 59. And then I left the station in 60. And then I left the station in 60. But I was with the station altogether for 27 years. But the Dawn Busters, as the Dawn Busters, this was the same band really.
Oh, who was the violinist that you had?
